PLAIN 1: THE HAUL. Pick up a crate of parts at one quiet site and take it to another. Nobody shoots.
A COMMON, NOT A SPECIAL: written to survive the tenth play. No reveal, no secret, no twist; the issuer has a small
ordinary stake and says it in one short line. What changes on a replay is the place, the drive and what is there
(his 09-23 'All the dials are new gameplay'). The register is his 07-31 'pure chill out Truck Simulator Dad Game
vibes', and his Goods Package (localcargo_qst09a) is the specimen. No pay promised in a voiced line (10-27).
Letters are the replay lever that exists: a b and c later, same job, other words, live side by side.
MB42a's shape without the guards: a pickup on the site's own storage spot (REContainerLocRef, replace, his
10-27 'make it a better marker'), a deliver at a second place, which on a board is a request. Pay: easy.
